classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve UniProt sequences annotated with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity (GO:0102088) and NADPHX epimerase activity (GO:0097028), perform compositional and motif-level biochemical analysis on both sets, then aggregate and rank the top representative NAD(P)HX repair protein candidates.
assumptions: GO:0102088 captures ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity and GO:0097028 captures NADPHX epimerase activity as established by the tool_selection prior; actual GO term labels will be confirmed at runtime by go_sequences.
IEA evidence codes are excluded from both go_sequences calls to retain only curated or experimentally supported annotations, improving annotation reliability.
Up to 200 sequences per GO term are retrieved with intra-set deduplication; no taxon filter is applied to maximise phylogenetic diversity of representatives.
sequence_analysis compositional metrics (length distribution, net charge, disordered regions, conserved motifs) serve as the primary scoring features passed to rank_designs.

ESM3 structural embedding is deferred to a follow-up round: a single representative amino-acid string must first be selected from rank_designs output before ESM3 can execute; this is a workflow sequencing constraint, not a scientific limitation.
Literature search provides biological context on the NAD(P)HX repair mechanism and may surface canonical representatives to guide manual follow-up ESM3 invocation.
rank_designs will aggregate both sequence candidate sets and both analysis metric records to produce a unified top-10 ranked list.
missing_inputs: A single concrete amino-acid sequence string is required to run ESM3; this cannot be resolved at planning time without first observing rank_designs output. ESM3 is listed in warm_tools and should be invoked in a follow-up round once a top candidate sequence is selected.

success_criteria.go_seqs_dehydratase: GO:0102088 returns kept_sequences > 0 and a valid fasta_path artifact
success_criteria.go_seqs_epimerase: GO:0097028 returns kept_sequences > 0 and a valid fasta_path artifact
success_criteria.literature_context: literature_search returns result_count >= 5 with abstracts covering NAD(P)HX repair mechanism
success_criteria.seq_analysis_dehydratase: sequence_analysis completes with non-empty metrics, representative_sequences, and top_annotations for the dehydratase set
success_criteria.seq_analysis_epimerase: sequence_analysis completes with non-empty metrics, representative_sequences, and top_annotations for the epimerase set
success_criteria.rank_candidates: rank_designs returns ranked_candidates list with top_k = 10 entries drawn from merged dehydratase and epimerase candidate sets, with ranked_json and ranked_tsv artifacts written

inputs.query: NAD(P)HX repair protein ADP-dependent dehydratase epimerase mechanism
